title: SimpleHomes
body:
SimpleHomes is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that lets players set and teleport to homes. Features:
Commands:
/sethome [name] - Save your current location (default "home")
/home [name] - Teleport to a saved home
/delhome <name> - Delete a home
/homes [player] [-p<page>] - List homes (admins can view others')
/homesadmin reload|help - Admin commands
Permissions:
simplehomes.limit.default (3 homes)
simplehomes.limit.vip (10 homes)
simplehomes.limit.* (unlimited)
simplehomes.homes.others (view others' homes)
Storage:
Homes saved in plugins/SimpleHomes/homes.yml
